What the service does

Dispatch support helps organize load options and communications around your equipment, lanes, and operating preferences.

01 / REVIEW

Founder Waitlist

Register before the list closes.

Founder eligibility is recorded when a registration is accepted. The list closes after five distinct carriers complete an eligible first invoice that has been paid and reconciled. There is no calendar deadline.

Join the Founder Waitlist

Current written scope: 53-foot Dry Van. Reefer coordination can be added after a signed amendment, truck review, written authorization, and capacity confirmation. No live location tracking, guaranteed loads, revenue claims, or automatic booking are represented.
